large_source_processing.terminal_cleanup: delete reproducible task-local derivatives; retain source/recipe lineage and internal Markdown notes

ingrained_details.resolved_cleanup: delete temporary unresolved row and its cascade trial history after final-home promotion
ingrained_details.queue_status: DB3 prompt_id is carried into durable task provenance so /queue can show current task/step instead of only a prompt prefix

operator_network_map.active_probe_policy: explicit config/network-map.json targets only; discovered peers never widen targets

voice_profile.profile_bindings: config/profiles.json selects user/N1/N2 voice/persona profiles independently

runtime_summary.semantics: end-of-task current-state projection, not historical supersession ledger
runtime_summary.same_turn_order: durable memory extraction/supersession before summary refresh
runtime_summary.failure_mode: retry one whole-state rebuild, then deterministic current-state fallback; never freeze stale prior summary
runtime_summary.generation_stream: silent while structured JSON is generated
runtime_summary.operator_output: publish one complete End-of-task durable summary event after successful/fallback persistence
runtime_summary.execution_request: conservative exact-span sidecar removal only; embedded task qualifiers remain verbatim

public_optional_plugins.ownership: checksum-first managed adapter: verify src before writes; matching src is untouched while trusted plugin.json/README metadata may refresh; mismatched Norm-owned src is repaired; non-src plugin state is preserved
public_optional_plugins.source: public Norm source package / plugin repository

public_plugin_install.policy: hash installed managed plugin src first; if target SHA matches, leave src untouched and refresh only changed trusted metadata; otherwise repair Norm src from packaged release, re-hash, then use pinned public source only if packaged repair still fails; missing plugins prefer public source
public_plugin_install.verification: exact trusted Schema-2 name/version/entrypoint/src-tree SHA; verification always precedes writes; public source is a second repair path and fresh-install source

plugin_settings.reconcile: startup and every PluginManager refresh/hot-swap; preserve declared operator values, fill missing/invalid values from defaults, prune dangling keys/sections after backup
plugin_settings.secrets: external environment/secrets file only; never plugins.ini
plugin_settings.backup_dedup: SHA-256 exact-content dedupe; identical states do not consume retention slots; legacy config/backups/plugins-ini is migrated and duplicate copies are collapsed

plugin_configuration.absent_behavior: Jan, Vane, OpenCode, and shared model-provider routing are disabled; existing Norm/Ollama behavior is unchanged
plugin_configuration.legacy_migration: Installer 1.6.10 migrates any 1.6.9 model_provider/remote_agents sections out of settings.ini and removes them from the core config

backup_retention.semantics: 12 newest backup sets per backup class/location; a backup ZIP plus its .sha256 companion counts as one set

n1_control_loop.flow: user -> N1 ingress review -> N2 -> N1 tool gate/verification-pool sufficiency -> N2 -> N1 final review -> user
n1_control_loop.ingress: N1 may attach advisory guidance but cannot rewrite or block the exact user turn
n1_control_loop.routing: N2 proposes subject decomposition/thread placement; N1 accepts or retries before persistence
n1_control_loop.tool_gate: For information requests N1 judges whether relevant live Redis verification-pool evidence is sufficient; sufficient evidence is replayed to N2, otherwise the source executes fresh. Repeated non-information paths remain loop-guarded.
n1_control_loop.final: N1 accepts/retries; N2 performs any repair; N1 does not rewrite the final answer
n1_control_loop.persistent_instructions: config/runtime.json:agents.n1.persistent_instructions; runtime-owned and preserved across model switches

subject_routing.existing_thread_policy: reuse only at confidence >= threshold; otherwise create a better subject thread or clarify
subject_routing.assistant_projection: verbatim excerpts only; failure falls back to primary thread only

model_runtime_policy.authority: config/runtime.json only; config/settings.ini, config/norm.json, and Modelfile do not own context size
model_runtime_policy.model_switch: changes model identity only; agent context and persistent instructions remain attached to runtime-owned clients and probes
model_runtime_policy.context_overflow: exceed_context_size_error yields into existing bounded oversize-recovery decomposition rather than identical HTTP retry
model_runtime_policy.shared_persistent_instructions: config/runtime.json:persistent_instructions; preserved from pre-0.54.1a live installs by generic JSON migration

profile_runtime.installer_semantics: schema-managed JSON: whole config directory is snapshotted before in-place sync; matching live values are merged into new schema
profile_runtime.model_switch: profile context is runtime-owned and remains attached when model identity changes

codex_reasoning.input: question plus evidence explicitly supplied by Norm

user_voice_history.source: PostgreSQL durable conversation messages with role=user only
user_voice_history.persona_policy: voice-only; never writes operator-authored user persona

chunked_evidence.scope: large default text read_file results delivered to N2
chunked_evidence.context_partition: measure current system/messages/tool schemas, reserve current N2 num_predict output plus safety, then target raw_evidence_fraction of remaining usable input
chunked_evidence.addressing: stable byte ranges within one source-fingerprint-locked stream; N2 may request any one numbered piece
chunked_evidence.eviction: after N2 consumes a chunk and emits its next tool call, raw text is replaced in active model history by compact provenance + retained facts; full raw tool evidence remains durable out of context
chunked_evidence.n1_verification: Chunked read_file calls use the same live Redis verification pool. N1 sees bounded candidate metadata/canonical values, judges sufficiency, and may replay exactly one prior raw chunk payload from Redis; canonical values are never substituted for requested file bytes. If prior evidence is insufficient or unavailable, the source is read fresh.
chunked_evidence.source_change: source_fingerprint mismatch invalidates the active stream and requires a fresh read

context_headroom_checkpoint.counter_source: Ollama prompt_eval_count plus estimated newly visible assistant payload; no full prompt rescan per turn
context_headroom_checkpoint.lossless_archive: norm_runtime.task_context_slices stores the recent execution slice in PostgreSQL before continuation
context_headroom_checkpoint.distillation: N1 converts the durable slice into task-applicable continuation state only; an assistant tool-call proposal without a following tool result is explicitly treated as unexecuted
context_headroom_checkpoint.resume: PromptQueue.yield_job requeues the same task/step with distilled job.context; the resumed slice uses the authoritative original request + current internal step + compact continuation/evidence cursors and skips bulk task working memory, prior-step, and background-memory reinjection; lossless PostgreSQL context remains available by reference
context_headroom_checkpoint.stream_cursor: chunked evidence stream states are carried in existing job metadata across the requeue

verification_pool_replay.authority: Redis live verification pool: compact metadata in norm:validation:pool plus raw payloads in the companion norm:validation:pool:replay hash, both keyed by the same record_id; no parallel in-process raw-result cache
verification_pool_replay.decision_owner: N1 judges whether one or more relevant prior observations are sufficiently applicable/current for N2's present information request; cost is not a decision criterion
verification_pool_replay.freshness: age alone does not determine staleness; N1 reasons from source volatility, requested freshness, known mutations/invalidation, scope, contradictions, and evidence completeness
verification_pool_replay.candidate_context: N1 scans only the compact metadata hash and receives bounded metadata/canonical values, age/check count, scope, and replay availability; raw replay payloads are fetched from the companion hash only after selection
verification_pool_replay.replay: after N1 selects sufficient evidence, the exact hot replay payload is fetched from Redis and supplied to N2; N2 need not know whether evidence was replayed or freshly observed
verification_pool_replay.multi_record: N1 may select up to validation_pool.max_replay_records relevant small observations; read_file remains limited to one raw evidence payload per N2 turn
verification_pool_replay.payload_limit: validation_pool.replay_payload_max_bytes bounds each private hot replay payload; oversized/unavailable payloads force fresh source execution rather than bloating N1 context
verification_pool_replay.mutation: known mutations invalidate affected Redis validation targets immediately; a moved/unreachable locator does not retroactively invalidate already observed cached content
verification_pool_replay.durability: PostgreSQL retains durable validation/history/checkpoint state; private replay payloads are Redis-hot evidence and are not copied into long-term validation history

remote_sse_client.transport: read-only HTTP server-sent events from activity /events over the configured tailnet host
remote_sse_client.configuration: builder resolves the installed network.current_machine/current_domain and activity_port at build time and embeds only the remote SSE endpoint
remote_sse_client.secrets: none; generated client does not embed Redis/PostgreSQL credentials or Norm secret environment values
remote_sse_client.portability: single Windows executable intended to be copied to another tailnet-connected Windows machine

task_round_budget.judge: N1 grants each additional bounded lease only for genuine forward progress rather than raw tool/activity volume
task_round_budget.manual_recovery: At the granted/hard boundary a resumable failure checkpoint is retained for /failed and /resume-failed; /flush-failed distills a reusable lesson before purging detailed failed-task state.

lesson_model.mode: operator-reviewed lessons + versioned code memory + topology
lesson_model.training_backend: not configured; training and auto-promotion disabled
lesson_model.source_retention: content-addressed wholesale ZIP copy; original input is never deleted

output_overflow.policy: retain full generated original and submit shortest complete summary; no bypass of N1/N2 verification

celery_tool_transport.n2: original active step and final conclusion remain N2-owned

parent_recovery_reconstruction.scope: failure preparation on original task before successor creation
parent_recovery_reconstruction.ledger: RedisTaskLog.record_evidence appends both legacy step events and compact returned-value list
parent_recovery_reconstruction.reconcile: cross-check Redis step execution plan/events with durable step-status snapshot and observed returns
parent_recovery_reconstruction.authority: N1 reviews remaining-step list; source-step coverage validation prevents omitted work
parent_recovery_reconstruction.successor: new task, new approved remaining-work steps; no copied parent ledger
parent_recovery_reconstruction.original_prompt: preserved verbatim as reference in each successor execution slice
parent_recovery_reconstruction.persistence: Redis only for supplemental ledger; no new PostgreSQL writes
parent_recovery_reconstruction.safety: failed parent preserved if reconciliation or N1 review fails

n1_celery_adaptive_wait.next_checks: N1 model selects next check delay; reassesses if still pending
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.deadline: From original dispatch; never resets on N1 estimates or restarts
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.execution_authority: N1.before_tool chooses reuse or Celery execution; N1.after_tool processes every returned result
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.tracking: Per-step receipts in Redis; delayed continuations Redis sorted set
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.sync_compatibility: Normal tool/yield path is unchanged; only approved information tools asynchronous
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.unresolved: Result status=unresolved, not falsely failed; Redis marker prevents same-task duplicate execution
n1_celery_adaptive_wait.ui: queue-full shows delayed Celery check jobs
